quotes.quote: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.
The web app talks to a scheduling service.
The scheduling service is what actually reads and writes the rotas, which live in a rota database.
Colleagues reach the app from their own phones.
Once a week the scheduling service writes a payroll export onto a file share.
The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.
